title: Variant-Owned Discovery Entry Operations
changes: Added a domain-specific LaravelControllerSourceDiscoveryEntry ADT with continueDiscovery operation.
Added an interface-first immutable upstream factory for directory, symbolic-link, PHP-source, and ignored entries.
Migrated CLI post-classification actions from a local string-keyed action table to the upstream ADT continuation.
Updated existing structural audits to assert the new contract rather than the retired local dispatch implementation.
remaining_root_cause_targets: filesystem error-code and root-versus-child classification still uses primitive OS error evidence
filesystem Dirent booleans remain an adapter-level classification boundary
directory iterator cursor currently has a type assertion
